name: KiWay Via Stitching
description: Preview net-aware copper-zone via stitching with geometric clearance exclusions.
description_full: Generates uniform or perimeter-weighted stitching inside the board or selected bounds, optionally constrained to filled target-net copper. It rejects footprint bodies, other-net tracks, vias, zones, keepouts, and drawings, previews board bounds and scaled via geometry, and commits a removable native KiCad group.
